---
title: "Load and share models"
description: "Load verified model bundles locally or from Hugging Face Hub profiles, then export or publish them."
---

## Model folders

A local model bundle is a directory with three files:

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `config.json` | Versioned model configuration, inference contract, compatibility record, and provenance |
| `model.safetensors` | Model parameters and persistent buffers in the safetensors format |
| `manifest.json` | File hashes, tensor metadata, and bundle identity |

[from_pretrained](../reference/inference.from_pretrained.qmd) verifies the folder before constructing an evaluation-mode model. It checks the manifest, configuration, and package compatibility; it does not unpickle code. [save_pretrained](../reference/inference.save_pretrained.qmd) writes only to a new or empty directory. Use [load_checkpoint](../reference/training.load_checkpoint.qmd) to load a training checkpoint for export.

```python
from pymc_mfm import from_pretrained
from pymc_mfm.inference import save_pretrained
from pymc_mfm.training import load_checkpoint

model = from_pretrained("runs/my-model/model", device="cpu")

checkpoint, payload = load_checkpoint("runs/my-model/checkpoint_last.pt")
save_pretrained(checkpoint, "models/my-model")
```

A training checkpoint contains model state and run records, not optimizer state. Export it as a model folder to load it with the local or Hub interface.

## Load from Hugging Face Hub

Hugging Face Hub support is included in the standard [installation](index.qmd#install-client); private repositories still require separate access. Pass a local directory or a Hub model repository to `from_pretrained`. A `Path`, an existing directory, an absolute path, or a path that starts with `.` or `~` is local; any other string names a Hub repository, so write `"./models/my-model"` for a relative folder. A repository can contain one root bundle or multiple bundles at `profiles/<name>/`; use `profile=` for the latter. [list_profiles](../reference/inference.list_profiles.qmd) discovers collection identities without downloading weights, reports, or corpora.

```python
from pymc_mfm import from_pretrained, list_profiles

profiles = list_profiles("pymc-labs/mfm")
revision = profiles["river-1"]["revision"]
river = from_pretrained(
    "pymc-labs/mfm",
    profile="river-1",
    revision=revision,
)
```

River-1 is loaded as `from_pretrained("pymc-labs/mfm", profile="river-1", revision=...)`; `mfm.load("river-1", **roles)` in [Get started](index.qmd) loads the same profile at a pinned commit. In `mfm.load`, the name `"river-1"` is reserved for that bundle, even if a folder named `river-1` exists; load such a folder as `mfm.load("./river-1", **roles)`. The collection is private to the PyMC Labs organization, so users outside PyMC Labs cannot download River-1's weights: they run River-1 on the [hosted River API](index.qmd#hosted-api) by invitation, or load a bundle of their own. See the [River-1 release notes](../models/river-1/index.qmd) for the release record.

Use a full commit in `revision=` for reproducibility. A branch or tag is resolved to one immutable commit before the bundle files are loaded, and `model.provenance["hub_revision"]` records that resolved commit. Reuse a listed revision to pin a later load.

Private repositories use `hf auth login`, `HF_TOKEN`, or the `token=` argument. Use `cache_dir=` to choose the cache location and `local_files_only=True` to require a populated cache without network access. Those options and `token=` follow Hugging Face Hub conventions. Local directory loads do not import the Hub client or perform network and authentication I/O.

::: {.callout-note}
## Pin the artifact

Omitting `revision=` resolves the repository's default branch. A full commit is the reproducible reference; offline loading succeeds only when that snapshot is already cached.
:::

## Export and publish

Use [push_to_hub](../reference/inference.push_to_hub.qmd) to export one complete bundle and publish its model card in one Hub commit.

```python
from pymc_mfm.inference import push_to_hub

commit = push_to_hub(
    model,
    "org/repo",
    profile="my-model",
    license="approved-license-identifier",
)
commit_id = commit.oid
```

New Hub repositories default to private; publication never changes an existing repository's visibility. The returned commit object carries the immutable commit id in `oid`. Publication requires an explicitly approved artifact license identifier. The code is licensed under Apache-2.0; model-weight licenses have not yet been selected.

## Choose an interface

| Need | Interface |
| --- | --- |
| Load a verified local folder | `from_pretrained("./path/to/model")` |
| Open a folder or Hub profile for `model.inference(context, query)` | `mfm.load(folder_or_repo, **roles)`, with the same `profile=`, `revision=` and `token=` |
| Discover a collection's profiles | `list_profiles("org/repo")` |
| Load one immutable Hub profile | `from_pretrained("org/repo", profile="name", revision="<full-commit>")` |
| Export a trained checkpoint | `load_checkpoint(...)` then `save_pretrained(...)` |
| Publish one bundle | `push_to_hub(...)` |
